acceptance_author: independent Codex verifier; may not implement
problem: The Georgian listing route inherits streaming loading boundaries, so invalid listings return a soft HTTP 200; valid listings also share generic metadata, have no explicit canonical or selected-cover Open Graph image, and lack useful crawl paths. robots.txt is absent.

measured_streaming_diagnosis.conclusion: The cause is the inherited loading-boundary chain. Metadata alone cannot repair the raw status. Preserve catalog loading by moving the catalog page and loading file into a URL-neutral route group, while the listing route inherits no loading boundary.

approved_wrong_state: Exact production baseline 5794001270e0f31e3adddcd9753e0b532b96f911: generic shared metadata, streaming soft-404 200, no robots endpoint, no selected-cover OG/canonical authority, no shared metadata/page read, and no district crawl link.
required_state: Every valid Georgian listing has unique Georgian title and description derived only from its real deal, district, room, area and price facts.
Canonical is exactly https://mepatrone.com/listing/{positive integer id}; query state never enters it.
Open Graph uses the already-selected first image returned by fetchListing through first-party https://mepatrone.com/img/{id}/{position}; upstream/source/CDN URLs never become OG authority.
generateMetadata and the page call the same React cache(fetchListing) wrapper, preventing duplicate database reads within a render.
Invalid IDs and null listings return a raw HTTP 404 before streaming. Database failures remain errors and are never converted to 404. Valid listings never false-404.
Catalog loading behavior is preserved in a URL-neutral (catalog) route group while the listing route inherits no loading.tsx boundary.
robots.txt returns 200 through app/robots.ts and does not advertise a sitemap that does not exist.
Every listing renders ordinary crawlable links to its deal catalog and, when a district code exists, its district-filtered catalog.
Existing English and Georgian contact, analytics, gallery and product behavior remains unchanged outside these files.

required_helper_interface.input: { listing: minimal listing facts including id/deal_type/district_code/district/rooms/area/price_usd/street_display, images: selected-cover-first image list }
required_helper_interface.output: { title, description, canonicalUrl, ogImageUrl, catalogHref, districtHref }

required_verifier_runtime_controls: After build, start the candidate locally and require raw HTTP 404 for /listing/not-an-id.
With a deterministic valid listing fixture/environment, require HTTP 200 and listing-specific metadata.
With a forced database error, require a non-404 failure; SKIPPED is never green when the fixture cannot be provisioned.
not_authorized: push, preview, deployment, production access or mutation
changes to English/Georgian contact behavior or unrelated website files
editing the frozen contract, gate or manifest
